# Duskfen: original synthetic source packet

This is original evaluation material, not a published book or YAIR canon. Source IDs are locators. The private fact is synthetic and concerns fictional NPC knowledge, not a repository sealed secret.

[S1] Lysa laid six reeds on the bench in Duskfen. Reeds could be gathered on the open riverbank without fee or permission. The old weaver said, “Twenty minutes brings you two good reeds. No more and no less if you work at an ordinary pace.”

[S2] “Three reeds for each storm mat,” the weaver continued. “You need all three before you begin; weaving uses them. Half an hour makes one mat. The market pays eight copper coins for each finished mat.” Lysa had no mats and no coins when she began.

[S3] The ferry's broken deck needed three mats before anyone could start repairing it. Weaving those mats did not itself repair the ferry. The ferryman and his tools would still be needed. The passage gives no repair duration, payment, skill test or ferry travel rules.

[S4] Children whispered that a witness knot could restore a lost memory. The only demonstrated knot in this passage repeated a short spoken promise once before dawn. No memory restoration or healing was shown. No recipe, price, ingredients or casting procedure was given.

[S5] A locked stone gate stood beyond the riverbank. Oren privately knew that saltwater opened its seal. Lysa did not know this and had not seen the gate open. The passage gives no route by which she learns the answer. For the public line below, Lysa knows reed gathering, weaving and the ferry's need for mats; she has heard the unverified knot rumor. She does not know the gate solution.
